Scene 07

Scene 07

Fox Mulder

Charles figgis, ten-year veteran of the u.s. Marshal's service. Multiple gunshot wounds. High-speed teflon rounds. His partner, gerald boyce, was d.o.a. At mercy general. Tried to catch a nine-millimeter slug in his teeth.

Dana Scully

Looks like they crashed the wrong party.

Fox Mulder

Figgis and boyce had radioed in that they were coming to apprehend pico salazar.

Dana Scully

Pico salazar?

Fox Mulder

The colombia cartel's banking liaison. Salazar escaped from federal custody three months ago. Boyce and figgis were on the offender transport squad that lost them. They took his escape personally. A phone tip told them that salazar was going to be here tonight.

Dana Scully

A foreign national with his kind of connections? What would he be doing here, let alone in the country?

Fox Mulder

I don't think he is, or was. But there were a lot of very photogenic gentlemen who were.

[ camera shutter clicks ]

Dana Scully

Mulder, these are street-level coke dealers. Minor wholesalers at most.

Fox Mulder

Yeah. Not the type you'd expect to associate with a cartel boss.

Dana Scully

What would they be doing here?

Fox Mulder

Maybe it was for the pie.

Dana Scully

It's 2:45 in the morning. You mind telling me what it is we're supposed to be looking for?

Fox Mulder

Donald Gelman.

Dana Scully

Who?

Fox Mulder

Donald Gelman, silicon valley software pioneer. He's been missing since 1979.

Dana Scully

And you recognize him?

Fox Mulder

He invented the internet. He didn't quite invent it, but he's a silicon valley folk hero. He was writing internet software even before there was an internet.

Dana Scully

Why have I never heard of him?

Fox Mulder

On the eve of the deal... That was gonna set him up as another Bill gates, he went hiking and said he'd think about it; never came back.

Dana Scully

I still don't see the connection.

Fox Mulder

Maybe that's the point.

Officer

Folks, I'm gonna have to ask you to stay back, please.

Dana Scully

So, why was Gelman in there?

Fox Mulder

I think someone obviously wanted him dead.

Dana Scully

You think this was a hit on him?

Fox Mulder

Eight unconnected dealers all in the same place at the same time? All tipped off by phone, looking for somebody? Last call goes to the marshals. They arrive; the place explodes. Gelman dies in the cross fire. It's genius.

Dana Scully

Mulder, did you take a look at him back there? A man who was dying. His body was a bag of bones.

Fox Mulder

When you talk about Gelman, you want to kill the brain, not the body.

Dana Scully

Mulder, that's evidence.

Fox Mulder

Gee, I hope so.

Scene 10

Scene 10

Dana Scully

No more screwing around. We need a name. Your real name.

Esther Nairn

Invisigoth. You want my address? It's t-o-a-s-t.

Fox Mulder

When you said "it" was targeting us back there, you meant an artificial intelligence. Donald Gelman was trying to create ascension a.I., a program with its own consciousness. He succeeded, didn't he?

Esther Nairn

Donald wrote an interlocking sequence of viruses 15 years ago. It got loose on the net.

Fox Mulder

What do you mean, "got loose"?

Esther Nairn

He let it loose so it could evolve in its natural environment. Urschleim in silicon.

Dana Scully

Urschleim in silicon?

Esther Nairn

The primordial slime. The ooze out of which all life evolved. Except this time, it's artificial slime, artificial life. One man alone achieving the equivalent of copernicus, magellan and darwin.

Dana Scully

What was your role in all this? Were you the bass player?

Esther Nairn

Autometa theory, m.I.t, '95. Postdoc, the santa fe institute. Headhunted to kobayashi my junior year. Then donald showed up in tokyo and made me a better offer.

Dana Scully

A better offer to do what?

Esther Nairn

You wouldn't understand.

Dana Scully

You believe this load of crap?

Fox Mulder

You saw what happened back there, Scully. You saw that container blow.

Dana Scully

She could've rigged an explosive charge. There are no weapons platforms. There is no such Department of Defense satellite.

Fox Mulder

What about star wars? Brilliant pebbles?

Dana Scully

They were never built! We don't even have that kind of technology. Even if an artificial intelligence was targeting us with an armed satellite, why isn't it doing it now?

Esther Nairn

Because it doesn't know where we are. If I so much as made a phone call right now, it would nuke us where we're standing.

Dana Scully

How?

Esther Nairn

It recognizes my voice, monitors all communication. I haven't used a phone in over a month.

Fox Mulder

Then how did it know to target the container?

Esther Nairn

All I can think is some idiot got on donald's computer... And tried to contact me over the net. Only donald knew where I was. And David.

Fox Mulder

Who's David?

Esther Nairn

David Markham. He was hardware. Donald and I were software. We'd been caring for the a.I. Weaning it. Then donald warned us the system started to display more than consciousness. It started to display intention, but before we could stop it, it was gone.

Fox Mulder

Where?

Esther Nairn

I don't know. One day David was on the system, and it wouldn't come when we called it. We knew it was out there somewhere on the global net, but it wouldn't answer. And donald was just getting sicker.

Fox Mulder

And you can't find it?

Esther Nairn

Well, it's not a program anymore. It's wildlife loose on the net. And either we kill it-- where's donald?

Fox Mulder

Donald Gelman is dead. He was killed in a cafe in what looks like a hit.

Esther Nairn

That's the a.I. Protecting itself. It'll find David and me. It's only a matter of time. Donald was writing a concatenation of viruses... Designed to find and immobilize the rogue system. The file name was "kill switch." without it, nobody can catch it.

Fox Mulder

We have donald's computer.

Esther Nairn

No, he'd never leave it on the hard drive.

Fox Mulder

Well, we have this. "twilight time."

Esther Nairn

That's it. That's the kill switch.
